frozen_criterion: Map the proposal to the original 1000 × 1000 image; round to the nearest pixel; place a 48 × 48 raw-intensity ROI.
boundary_and_role: The ROI must lie completely inside the image; it is rejected rather than clipped or padded.
failure_handling: No proposal or an out-of-bounds ROI produces a missing measurement.

frozen_criterion: Fit result, R², fitted parameters, and center uncertainties must be finite; center uncertainties must be nonnegative.
boundary_and_role: Gaussian-acceptance gate applied identically to all compared methods in this regime.
All four bounds are strict; coordinates are local to the 48 × 48 ROI.

frozen_criterion: Initialize the center at the smoothed intensity maximum within 16.32 px of the ROI center; bound each fitted center coordinate to ±16.32 px from the ROI center.
boundary_and_role: Solver constraint, not a post-fit performance metric.
failure_handling: Fit failure produces a missing measurement.

frozen_criterion: Euclidean distance between the proposal and Gaussian-refined center ≤ 15 px.
boundary_and_role: Gaussian-acceptance gate applied identically to all compared methods in this regime.

frozen_criterion: Euclidean distance between an accepted Gaussian center and the frozen expected radial branch ≤ 18 px.
boundary_and_role: Evaluation gate applied after Gaussian acceptance; it does not move the proposal or fitted center.
failure_handling: A fit beyond 18 px remains an accepted Gaussian fit but is classified as geometry-inconsistent.

frozen_criterion: No interpolation, carry-forward, manual correction, or within-run reinitialization.
boundary_and_role: Applies after unavailable proposals, out-of-bounds ROIs, fit failures, or gate failures.
failure_handling: The predefined opportunity remains in its fixed denominator.

frozen_criterion: D_ref is the median of valid pair distances in the first 10 images, requiring at least 8 valid distances.
boundary_and_role: Eligibility rule for each method–pair relative endpoint, not a Gaussian-acceptance gate.
failure_handling: If fewer than 8 of 10 distances are valid, the entire relative endpoint is unavailable.
